messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask to compute the standard deviation? Actually they say "計算...的零假設檢定的標準差" which might mean compute the standard error or the standard deviation of the sampling distribution? They want to get the population mean 98.6. So we need to compute the standard error of the mean: SE = sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40)=6.3249. 1.4/6.3249=0.2213 approx. So standard error ~0.221. Then maybe compute t-statistic: (sample_mean - population_mean)/SE = (98.2-98.6)/0.2213 = (-0.4)/0.2213 = -1.807. Then degrees of freedom df=39. Then compute p-value two-tailed: p = 2 * P(T <= -1.807) with df=39. We can approximate using t distribution. For df=39, t=1.807 gives p ~ 0.08? Let's approximate: For df=30, t=1.697 gives p=0.10; t=2.042 gives p=0.05. So t=1.807 likely p ~0.09. So p-value ~0.09. But the question: "以得到人口平均值為98.6" maybe they want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution? Or compute the standard error? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" could refer to the standard error used in the test. So answer: Standard error = 1.4/sqrt(40) ≈ 0.221. Then t-statistic = (98.2-98.6)/0.221 ≈ -1.81.
